changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Theme') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Theme]( ID int identity not null, Uid uniqueidentifier not null, Name nvarchar(250) not null, IsCurrent bit not null, HeaderLogoExtension varchar(5) null, HomePageBackgroundExtension varchar(5) null, BrowserIconExtension varchar(5) null, BackColor varchar(7) null, BreadcrumbLinkColor varchar(7) null, ButtonBackColor varchar(7) null, PrimaryButtonBackColor varchar(7) null, HeaderBackColor varchar(7) null, NavBarBackColor varchar(7) null, NavBarBackSelectedColor varchar(7) null, TabLinkColor varchar(7) null, TableHeaderBackColor varchar(7) null, TableRowBackSelectedColor varchar(7) null, CustomCss nvarchar(max) null, CreatedBy int not null, CreatedOn datetime not null, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, Locked bit constraint DF_Theme_Locked default(0) not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_Theme] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( ID ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Theme' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Locked') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Theme] ADD Locked bit constraint DF_Theme_Locked default(0) not null END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Theme') BEGIN drop table dbo.[Theme] END
